id.description: The unique identifier of the hat

name.description: The name of the gift exchange

status.description: The current status of the gift exchange

additionalInformation.description: Additional details about the gift exchange

priceRange.description: The suggested price range for gifts

organizer.description: The organizer of the gift exchange

participants.description: The list of participants in the gift exchange

invitationsQueuedDate.description: When invitations were queued for sending

email.description: The email address of the person

pickedRecipient.description: The name of the person this participant will give a gift to

eligibleRecipients.description: The list of potential recipients for this participant

deliveryStatus.description: How far the last email sent to this participant is known to have got: SENT, DELIVERED, DELAYED, BOUNCED, COMPLAINED, REJECTED or FAILED. Empty when nothing has been heard yet, which is not the same as not delivered.

deliveryDetail.description: Why, for the statuses that have a why: the bounce subtype and the receiving server's diagnostic. Empty otherwise. Written by a remote mail server, so it is neither moderated nor trusted.
